ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ca165a9d57fcde4da19b2a649cb1792ffe961405"
PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from collections import Counter
from PIL import Image
from sqlmodel import Session, create_engine, select
from app.core.config import DATABASE_URL
from app.models.photo import Photo
from app.services.photo_media import private_photo_image_path, photo_image_media_type
engine=create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
counts=Counter()
mimes=Counter()
failed=[]
samples={}
with Session(engine) as s:
    photos=list(s.exec(select(Photo).where(Photo.status=='approved').order_by(Photo.id)).all())
for p in photos:
    if not p.original_path.lower().endswith('.bin'):
        continue
    path=private_photo_image_path(p)
    try:
        with Image.open(path) as im:
            fmt=str(im.format)
    except Exception as exc:
        fmt='ERROR:' + type(exc).__name__
        failed.append((p.id, str(path), repr(exc)))
    counts[fmt]+=1
    mime=photo_image_media_type(path)
    mimes[mime]+=1
    samples.setdefault(fmt, (p.id, str(path), mime))
print('bin_count=' + str(sum(counts.values())))
print('formats=' + repr(dict(counts)))
print('helper_mimes=' + repr(dict(mimes)))
print('samples=' + repr(samples))
print('failures=' + repr(failed[:10]))
PY
REMOTE
